name: subtitle-preflight
description: 字幕投放前体检：单文件 HTML，浏览器内解析 SRT/VTT/ASS，按四类确定性规则体检并导出带行号定位的报告。

scripts.gate: node tools/check-sprint-layout.mjs && node tools/check-ruleset.mjs && node tools/check-truth.mjs && node tools/selftest-layout.mjs

scripts.verify: npm run gate && npm run samples:check && npm test && node tools/build.mjs --check
